$comment: Advisories the shared npm audit lets through, read from main on every run (docs/workflows.md#audit-allowlist). Only for advisories with no fix that are unreachable or acceptable. Every entry needs a reason and an until date; after it the entry stops applying.

entries.reason: No fix: braces 3.0.3 is the latest. It arrives through @metricinsights/pp-dev -> http-proxy-middleware -> micromatch. http-proxy-middleware only calls micromatch for string or glob pathFilters, and pp-dev passes a function, so no pattern, and nothing from a request, reaches braces.
